http/connection#

HTTP/1 connections for a client: TCP to an address already checked, racing the candidates a little apart, then TLS when the URL is https.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

HTTP/1 connections for a client: TCP to an address already checked, racing the candidates a little apart, then TLS when the URL is https. HttpTransport uses it.

object HttpAcquisitionCleanup#

object HttpAcquisitionCleanup<T>

Own the raw result before eager adaptation. A granted successful connection can become unclaimed when cancellation wins; it must be explicitly disposed.
